scripts.build: bun run --env-file=.env --env-file=.env.prod --filter '@tqx-ai/*' build && bun run plugin:claude:build && bun run plugin:antigravity:build
scripts.pack:check: bun run plugin:claude:check && bun run plugin:antigravity:check && bun pm pack --cwd packages/sdk --dry-run && bun pm pack --cwd packages/cli --dry-run && bun run test:package
scripts.publish:cli: bun run build && bun publish --cwd packages/cli --access public --tag latest
scripts.publish:sdk: bun run build && bun publish --cwd packages/sdk --access public --tag latest
scripts.release:check: bun run release:preflight && bun run test && bun run pack:check
scripts.typecheck: bun check && bun check --project packages/mcp-server/scripts/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/mcp-server typecheck:ui
scripts.test: bun run docs:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build && bun run test:smoke
